messages:
jordan: Quick flag 1: seeing funcall JSON truncation on the new pegasus-int4 canary. ~1.8% parse failures on mirror traffic.

lia: Any pattern? streaming vs non-streaming?

jordan: Mostly streaming, long optional metadata arrays. The detokenizer sometimes emits a stray newline + cut byte at end. Example truncated suffix:
```
... \"notes\": [\"alpha\", \"beta\"], \"meta\": [\"x\", \"y\"\n```
(no closing ])

sam: Could be quant detokenize drop or premature stream close. We saw similar with small kvcache margins.

maya: Short mitigation: enable a post-stream UTF-8 + JSON terminator scanner that, if invalid, appends a small safe sentinel token and tags request for async repair. Also flip on repair heuristics only for optional arrays.

oscar: Agree but gate repairs by schema-path and emit repaired_field telemetry. Do not invent required keys.

jordan: Plan: pause canary rollout, enable sentinel padding flag (runtime.opt_tail_sentinel=true), conservative repair for optional leaves, run 200k mirror A/B, collect parse_failures_by_path + repair_latency.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: enable opt_tail_sentinel on pegasus-int4-canary (3 nodes).

lia: Add a unit test that simulates last-byte truncation and asserts repair doesn't create required fields.

maya: If residual parse failures <0.25% we can regradually roll. Otherwise revert to float baseline.

jordan: dropping token dumps to /infra/benchmarks/pegasus-int4/trace-1767770000.log and will post results here.
